title: Den Bosch upset ZZ Leiden to capture DBL trophy
description: ZZ Leiden - Den Bosch 74-81 Den Bosch clinched DBL title. They outgunned ZZ Leiden on the road in the decisive fifth game of the championship series to lift the trophy. The guests trailed by 5 points after first quarter, but they rallied back to get the 3-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 81-74. Den Bosch made 21-of-25 free shots (84.0 percent) during the game. Den Bosch outrebounded ZZ Leiden 39-26 including 29 on the defensive glass. They looked well-organized offensively handing out 22 assists. The best player for the winners was American forward Clay Mounce (201-1998, college: Furman) who scored 23 points. The former international center Thomas van der Mars (208-1990, college: Portland, agency: Duran International) chipped in 6 points and 16 rebounds.
